<meta>continues from previous page</meta>The purity of the knower is the purity of body-consciousness. That which is the purity of body-consciousness is the purity of the knower. Thus, the purity of the knower and the purity of body-consciousness are not two; they cannot be divided, they are not separate, and they are not distinct.

The purity of the seer is the purity of body-consciousness. That which is the purity of body-consciousness is the purity of the seer. Thus, the purity of the seer and the purity of body-consciousness are not two; they cannot be divided, they are not separate, and they are not distinct.

<summary>This page discusses the non-dual nature of the knower, the seer, and body-consciousness, emphasizing that their essential purity is identical and inseparable. It reflects the Prajnaparamita philosophy of the unity of subject and object.</summary>
<keywords>purity, body-consciousness, non-duality, knower, seer, Buddhist philosophy, Prajnaparamita</keywords>
